page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number left and title centred. Below the running head, the text column continues; a ornamental rule separates the text from the new chapter heading "CAPUT XII." followed by a title and the opening paragraph with a large initial. A small mark at right margin edge is not text.

main_text.p: narunt: inpofterum novus textus Hebræus, aut saltem novis, neque hactenus visis, variis lectionibus ad marginem adscriptis, instructus, adornabitur ex Vulgata Versione & LXX. Interpp. Longè aliter hactenus statuerunt saniores Interpretes.

Ex illis hac vice pro conclusione hujus capitis duos tantum producam, & quidem diversæ circa sacra Professionis, sed hic pulchrè consentientes & conspirantes, ne me solum ita morosum, & Hebraicis codicibus addictum, subinde conqueratur Criticus.

Primus est Johannes Drusius, Academiæ Franekeranæ Professor Hebræus olim celeberrimus, qui ad Num. 22. v. 5. ubi in Vulgata Versione legitur; Qui habitat super flumen terræ filiorum Ammon, sic scribit: Verba sunt Interpretis nostri, quem Vulgatum vocitant, quæ ut enarranda relinquo, qui ejus textum pro authentico habent. Ego scio in fonte haberi, Terra filiorum populi sui: i. e. popularium suorum. Error legentis עַמּוֹ pro עַמָּי, quod sonat, Populi sui, i. e. λαοῦ αὐτῆς, quemodo Senes LXX. Nec aliter cæteri translatores. Quis ergo hic dicet, Textum Hebraeum ex Latino corrigendum esse? Quis? nisi malè sanum caput? Nam ipsa res clamat, Lectionem Hebraeam sinceram esse, quam omnes Interpretes præter nostrum secuti sunt.

Alter est Guilelmus Estius, Jesuita, in caput I. Epist. ad Hebræos, ad illa verba ex Psal. 97. v. 7. Et adorent eum omnes Angeli Dei; scribens: Non in hoc loco tantum, sed in multis aliis, Septuaginta, seu verè seu apparenter, discrepant à fonte Hebræo, quem proinde reformare velle ad illorum versionem, præposterum sit, & infiniti negotii.
main_text.head: CAPUT XII. De Variis Lectionibus, quæ deprehendi possunt ex Judæorum scriptis, Talmude, Rabboth, Massorâ, & Rabbinorum Commentariis.
main_text.p: Cum capitis xii. lib. 5. Criticæ Titulum, quem hic præscriptum legis, vidissem, avidè ad ejus lectionem me accinxi, sperans, me tandem singularia & ad præsens negotium magis facientia

page.notes: Printed page is 806 (top left). Heading "CAPUT XII." and title are set large; the title of the chapter is given as a level 1 head. Opening initial "C" is a large woodcut initial joined to "Cum". Hebrew words in the Drusius paragraph are rendered in Hebrew letters as far as legible; the transliteration of the Hebrew forms is approximate. Lower right word "cientia" is the printed continuation at the line end, shown as "facientia". Faint printer's marks and show-through omitted.
